name: fitness-platform
description: Gym & fitness class-booking platform built with Node.js microservices, an API gateway, PostgreSQL and Kafka

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n gateway,member,class,booking "npm start -w api-gateway" "npm start -w member-service" "npm start -w class-service" "npm start -w booking-service"
scripts.migrate: npm run migrate -w member-service && npm run migrate -w class-service && npm run migrate -w booking-service
